notes.title: Major Demo Update + August Devlog!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]Today we're releasing the biggest update to the demo yet, introducing some massive changes to not only the look of the game, but the feel of the game. [/p][p][/p][h1]Improved Lighting[/h1][p][/p][p]We've overhauled the first level quite a bit visually, giving it a more darker tone overall. Interiors in the first level have gotten a huge upgrade visually. Before interiors we're very flat, only lit by SSAO. Now we've introduced a more hand-tuned lighting system, allowing us to get much more realistic and pleasant results. This change has no performance cost other than a slight memory increase. Ray tracing of course builds on this improvement looking even better than before, if you so choose to turn it on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477845/e168e76918c225507165adfbaba3e2bdae215a99.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Bye-bye healing and grenade slots.[/h1][p][/p][p]One of the big mechanical changes in this update addresses healing and throwables. Before, you had a slot in your inventory for both healing and throwables. Bandages would automatically be placed, and your first throwable would automatically be placed. After that, it was all on you. This was [b]janky[/b]. We've now introduced a radial menu for both healable and throwables. This eliminates any accidental usage of items and generally just feels much better, while also solving the med-kit issue. The game speed is slower but not stopped, meaning you can still get hit in this state if you take too long or don't have cover.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477845/5dab59a40325c167d1776a9a200330bf92a3ef69.png"][/img][/p][h1]Resource scarcity and management[/h1][p][/p][p]One of the more inconsistent design issues we found was the amount of bandages and ammunition players we're ending up with at the end of the demo. This was largely dependent on play styles. If you explored every corner and looted every body, you ended up with way too many resources. If you instead rushed through to progress, you ended up with barely enough. This is a very tricky and complex game design issue and something we're always looking at. Here's how we've addressed it in this update.[/p][list][*][p]All ammunition picked up has been reduced by [b]20%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]On the 'Tactical' difficulty, ammo has been reduced again by [b]25%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Guns found now will drop a variable amount instead of being fully loaded[/p][/*][/list][p]The changes above should address the over abundance of ammo, especially on tactical difficulty. As we see it, the tactical difficulty should be much more resource scarce than casual, resulting in a more intense combat environment. In the full game, we're probably going to go with a more dynamic system that will depend on how much ammo you already have for a certain gun, etc.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gunplay and fluidity[/h1][p][/p][p]One of the major initial complaints we received was about fluidity. We've addressed some of this in the previous small patches but we've made big strides in the gunplay department. Animations have been changed and modified to allow for smoother gunplay. We've animated new walking animations for each gun, and heavily modified all fire animations. We've also improved weapon audio, fixing a bug where the audio would be cut short. We've also completely changed how aiming works. Instead of coming from the barrel, hip-fire shots will now aim at center screen. To accompany this change, we've also added a crosshair option in the gameplay section. It is defaulted to off. Weapons have also been modified to aim a little closer in when aiming. Most notably the XM4 got a big buff in this aspect.[/p][p][/p][h1]Human AI[/h1][p][/p][p]Oh where do I begin. JK. Anyways, Human AI is going to be evolving constantly but we've put some work in to improve it's feel and make them more tactical. One of the big issues with the AI is the randomness. That's why some players think they feel great and some think they're... well not smart. We're likely to completely overhaul AI in the near future, but for now we've added a couple of new states. [/p][list][*][p]Some AI now have set paths they can walk along in the bases, instead of just standing there.[/p][/*][*][p]AI can now see dead bodies and search the perimeter if not already in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]AI can now see better and act smarter when the player is leaning.[/p][/*][*][p]Previous patch added flanking and confidence systems[/p][/*][*][p]Increased difficulty on casual mode[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope these changes will satisfy. If they don't, then feel free to talk sh*t in the community hub. I'll be reading.[/p][p][/p][h1]Performance Improvements[/h1][p][/p][p]We've managed to significantly improve the consistency of performance. We've addressed several issues regarding loading and saving, audio loading, and prefab warmups. We've also introduced a system that will constantly be cutting a cost of our CPU budget instead of creating a huge cost at random. This should resolve any major stuttering or consistent framerate issues. It's been a big goal to have buttery smooth performance and we're getting very close.[/p][p][/p][h1]Looking forward[/h1][p][/p][p]We're now entering into our content production phase. We will fully be focused on the full game from now on. We do have big changes planned for the demo, such as remaking the first 10 minutes of the demo. But this won't happen for a little bit.  Of course if bugs arrive and are reported, small patches will go out. We'll be looking for testers for new content in our discord, and we'll of course be doing monthly dev-logs. Before I go, I'll share a little sneak peek of one of the levels in development. Screenshot is in game. [/p][p][/p][p][b](Work in progress)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477845/6aae9efb0f0dd1b1b957ce3677a93e1152fea631.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Many thanks,[/p][p]Shadow Project Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 03
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This update will be the biggest one to the demo so far, and marks a comfortable technical state. I've addressed the main stuttering cause, as well as greatly improved the fluidity of combat and general movement. All weapon animations have been tweaked to accommodate.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the detailed list of changes and additions:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced all weapon running animations, replaced XM4 animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed common stutters on all systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new human AI behaviors. AI now has a confidence system, determined by nearby friendlies and their health pool. AI will now also flank more intelligently and work together. If alone, the AI will be much more timid.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Silenced XM4 audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the time it takes to aim in on all weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Items will now try to rotate to fit in your inventory before saying inventory full.[/p][/*][*][p]Highlighted items in the inventory are now more defined making it easier to navigate.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased walk speed by 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crouch speed by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered inertia on all player movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all scaling issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Much more[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The following updates from now on will follow a longer cycle and will improve things that are more core to the game. More optimizations to the general performance will also be coming in the near future. We hope to hear from feedback from you guys as we continue to develop the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Many thanks,[/p][p]Shadow Project Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 02
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We've been listening to the feedback from the community and wanted to respond with a small gameplay patch that should address some of the issues mentioned. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased player movement speed by 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased movement speed during healing by 66%[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so you cannot use bandages when full health[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly enhanced Twin Mutant's run animation[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Twin Mutant HP by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced AK47 aiming animations to more align with the iron sight[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned XM4 animations transitions to be much tighter, resulting in more smooth gunplay[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly enhanced feedback on what a bullet hits. Both audio and visual[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope these changes will enhance the gameplay experience for the players who we're finding issues or frustration. In some cases laughter (Twin Mutant animation).[/p][p][/p][p]Many Thanks,[/p][p]Shadow Project Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 01
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I've seen some issues regarding the games scaling being wrong on startup, presumably due to windows scaling issues. I believe I have remedied this but I cannot reproduce this issue so beware. But if you had this issue, delete all settings files in 'C:\\Users\\Name\\AppData\\LocalLow\\SK Studios\\Shadow Project DEMO' and give it a go. I'd love to know if this solved it for you.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed resolution scaling by relying on system aspect ratio, instead of monitor aspect ratio.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3840x1600 as an option.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Many thanks,[/p][p]Shadow Project Team[/p]

notes.notes: [p][b]Shadow Project's official demo is launching August 8th![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477845/aa5673f5dc3d8bce21f2daf0f42befd3f153d842.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3638110/Shadow_Project_Demo/"]demo page[/url] is now live with details on what's included. It's been a lot of work since the reveal to have a polished product, truly, and we hope you enjoy it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Some of the things included in the demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b] Six full tracks from our amazing composer for the OST[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] One hour of gameplay[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] Full optimization and UX[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mark it on your calendar, I won't spoil the rest![/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]On the other side of the news, we've had to push Shadow Project back to [b]2026[/b]. Because we want to aim for such a high-quality bar, while still being a full-length video game, it's the right choice. We're also looking for your feedback and support in our [url="https://discord.gg/Utn4hVnD5F"]Discord[/url], where I will share development updates frequently.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477845/38ca69458c35d4dd89098dd7bce6591b7bc3d724.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also had to change our studio name due to copyright issues.
